note: Native images/stills; no retouching, generative changes or upscaling. Review JPEGs are reduced copies. Full-trim PPI assumes a fill crop at 185 x 240 mm, excludes bleed, and does not establish optical quality or composition.

candidates.title: Peas, just picked
candidates.strength: A clear foreground harvest, with the living crop behind it. The strongest link between growing and eating.
candidates.limitation: Mostly green; very close peas are soft. The top is textured, so a separate cream title area would be safer than lettering directly on the foliage.

candidates.title: Elephant garlic on wood
candidates.strength: Quiet colour, tactile skins and simple arrangement. The most restrained still-life direction.
candidates.limitation: The nearest bulb is soft and the image can read as a cookery book. A vertical crop must preserve both bulbs; test a framed landscape treatment first.

candidates.title: Picking salad leaves
candidates.source_path: /Volumes/five_backup/Videos backup 11 May 2026/Movies/May 2026/May Meal From My Garden/DJI_20260510115152_0140_D.MP4
candidates.strength: Hands, fresh leaves and the colander make the activity immediately understandable.
candidates.limitation: Hard sun, pale paving and deep shadow occupy much of the image. Prefer an image panel; a full-height portrait crop would lose useful context.

candidates.title: Showing the salad harvest
candidates.source_path: /Volumes/five_backup/Videos backup 11 May 2026/Movies/May 2026/May Meal From My Garden/DJI_20260510114410_0138_D.MP4
candidates.strength: An engaging grower-with-harvest scene, with eyes open at this exact frame.
candidates.limitation: Mid-speech expression, bright sun and greenhouse bars. Stronger for the back or supporting literature than an uncluttered front.

candidates.title: A tray of red chillies
candidates.strength: Strong red/green contrast and an abundant, repeatable pattern. Newly found on NODE NAME.
candidates.limitation: One crop dominates; the baking tray suggests the kitchen. Could work as a tightly framed photographic panel, with quiet typography outside it.

candidates.title: Carrot and beetroot in the soil
candidates.strength: Two unmistakable vegetables, soil still attached, with growing foliage behind. The most direct new harvest composition.
candidates.limitation: Only 1600 x 1200 pixels. Good for a smaller panel; unsuitable as a finely detailed full-height cover at this trim without accepting low resolution.

candidates.title: Tomatoes on the vine
candidates.strength: Recognisable fruit and a clear sense of growth; red fruit behind green adds depth.
candidates.limitation: Foreground fruit is not ripe, and greenhouse structure competes. Focal detail is softer than the pixel count suggests.

candidates.title: Courgette and flower
candidates.strength: A bright yellow focal point against green foliage; clearly a growing plant.
candidates.limitation: Strong sunshine clips some detail; surrounding stems and damaged leaves are busy. A single crop does not convey the breadth of the book.

candidates.title: Spade beside brassicas
candidates.strength: An inherently vertical gardening image, with a simple recognisable tool.
candidates.limitation: Bright sky, hedge and worn leaves compete. Better as a contextual detail than the main promise of a vegetable guide.

candidates.title: Stringing onions
candidates.strength: An authentic practical scene with stored produce and a naturally vertical composition.
candidates.limitation: Older image (file EXIF: 2013), only 1200 x 1600. Useful for personal history or a small supporting portrait, subject to John confirming its use.

candidates.title: Seated in the greenhouse
candidates.strength: Calmer posture with crops on either side; a useful contemporary author-image alternative.
candidates.limitation: Some squinting, hard highlights and a dark tub behind the head. Needs a deliberate crop.

candidates.title: At the plot with a spade
candidates.strength: A full-length photograph with a relaxed pose; higher-resolution source for a possible author treatment.
candidates.limitation: Face is shaded and houses dominate the background. A closer crop would be more useful than the entire scene.
